description: Fully replaces the structure of groups and monitors on the page (idempotent replace, not merge). For each group: `name`, `order`, optional `description`, and `servers` — each item has `server_id` (from `monitor_list`), display `name`, `order`, optional `description`. Pass the existing group `id` to update a group, omit it to create a new one. Anything missing from the payload is removed.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

id.description: Existing group id (omit to create a new group).

order.description: Display order of the group on the page.

description.description: Optional comment shown under the server name.

name.description: Display name shown on the status page.

server_id.description: Server id from the account-wide monitor list (`monitor_list`).

name: status_page_set_groups
title: Replace status page groups & monitors
